title: ReRead: Wrong Predictions, Useful Representations - Correcting Frozen Robot Policies by Re-reading Their Own Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.20465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a pretrained robot policy fails on challenging tasks, common remedies include retraining the backbone, adding an external visual encoder, or introducing a memory module. We argue that wrong predictions do not imply wrong representations: a policy can retain the required information yet fail to read it out as the correct action. To test this view, we propose ReRead: with the backbone frozen, a corrector re-reads the current and two previous caches to predict an action residual. The corrector sees no images, is trained solely on offline demonstrations from all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and adds only 4.17% latency. Ablations and interventions show that the correction relies on the backbone's own representations: none of four external visual encoders adds further gain, and swapping in past caches from other trajectories sharply increases action error. On the 11 hardest RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ReRead improves the success rates of LingBot-VLA,

translated_title: ReRead：错误的预测，有用的表征——通过重新读取自身表征来纠正冻结的机器人策略
translated_abstract: 当预训练的机器人策略在具有挑战性的任务上失败时，常见的补救措施包括重新训练主干网络、添加外部视觉编码器或引入记忆模块。我们认为，错误的预测并不意味着错误的表征：策略可能已经保留了所需的信息，却无法将其读取为正确的动作。为了验证这一观点，我们提出了ReRead：在主干网络冻结的情况下，一个纠正器重新读取当前及之前两次的缓存以预测动作残差。该纠正器不接收任何图像输入，仅使用来自全部50个RoboTwin 2.0任务的离线演示数据进行训练，且仅增加4.17%的延迟。消融实验和干预实验表明，这种纠正依赖于主干网络自身的表征：四种外部视觉编码器均未带来额外增益，而将来自其他轨迹的历史缓存替换进来则会显著增加动作误差。在RoboTwin 2.0最难的11个任务上，ReRead提高了LingBot-VLA的成功率，
tldr: 提出ReRead方法，在冻结主干网络的前提下，利用纠正器重新读取策略自身当前与历史缓存表征来预测动作残差，证明错误预测不等于错误表征，从而以极小的开销和训练成本纠正失败的动作输出。
en_tdlr: ReRead corrects frozen robot policies by re-reading their own current and historical cached representations to predict action residuals, demonstrating that wrong predictions do not imply wrong representations.
